scope: First frozen unseen prompt/seed screen; automated proxies, not an independently annotated benchmark
mask_method: Largest 4-connected source red HSV component, frozen from source only before target runs; independent of attention localization
geometry: Target-color component with largest overlap with frozen source color mask; IoU, centroid distance and area ratio of colored regions, not full-object silhouettes
background: RGB MAE outside frozen source-colored-region mask dilated by 8 pixels; same mask for every variant
missing_policy: Keep every case and failed/missing run; invalid source masks do not receive a pass and are reported separately
